statement.p: Match the solutions to the differential equations. If there is more than one solution to an equation, select the answer that includes all solutions.

li.p: y = e^{-7 x} or y = e^{7 x}

static.solution:
\frac{d}{dx} (e^{-7 x}) = -7 e^{-7 x},
\frac{d^2}{dx^2} (e^{-7 x}) = 49 e^{-7 x},
\frac{d}{dx} (e^{7 x}) = 7 e^{-7 x},
\frac{d^2}{dx^2} (e^{-7 x}) = 49 e^{-7 x},
\frac{d}{dx} (\sin(7 x)) = 7 \cos(7 x),
\frac{d^2}{dx^2} (\sin(7 x)) = -49 \sin(7 x),
\frac{d}{dx} (7 \sin(x)) = 7 \cos(x), and
\frac{d^2}{dx^2} (7 \sin(x)) = -7 \sin(7 x).
Thus, the correct answers are:
\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}=49 y : E,
\frac{dy}{dx}=-7 y : B,
\frac{dy}{dx}=7 y : D, and
\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}=-49 y : A
